title: Artificial Intelligence Index Report 2023
measurement_description: The report evaluated bias and fairness in AI models, specifically measuring stereotype bias and the propensity of models to fall back on stereotypes in ambiguous contexts along the demographic axis of religion.
findings: Models evaluated on the BBQ (Bias Benchmark for Question Answering) benchmark exhibited varying degrees of bias in the 'Religion' category, frequently relying on stereotypes when answering questions in ambiguous contexts. Furthermore, models evaluated on the VLStereoSet benchmark (vision-language models) demonstrated measurable stereotypical bias along the religion axis.
references: BBQ: A Hand-Built Bias Benchmark for Question Answering
VLStereoSet: A Study of Stereotypical Bias in Pre-trained Vision-Language Models
